title: Source-cited research brief from public web pages and news
description: Send a research question or topic, optionally with URLs to use as evidence. ZERO-INBOX fetches the named pages and official documentation, falls back to news search, and returns a Markdown brief that cites only pages actually retrieved, states the UTC retrieval date and calls out evidence gaps instead of guessing.

output.summary: Markdown brief with exact source URLs beside claims, UTC retrieval date and stated evidence gaps.
